#!/bin/bash
# Run Kestrel-4 benchmark pipeline
set -e

MODEL_PATH="/opt/models/checkpoints/model_v4.ckpt"
OUTPUT_DIR="/home/assistant/results/$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
LOG_FILE="$OUTPUT_DIR/benchmark.log"

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

echo "Starting Kestrel-4 benchmark at $(date)" | tee "$LOG_FILE"
echo "Model: $MODEL_PATH" >> "$LOG_FILE"
echo "Output: $OUTPUT_DIR" >> "$LOG_FILE"

# Run stress test
python3 /home/assistant/scripts/stress_test.py \
    --model-path "$MODEL_PATH" \
    --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
    --duration 72 \
    --batch-size 256 \
    --log-file "$LOG_FILE" >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1

# Analyze results
python3 /home/assistant/scripts/analyze_results.py \
    --input-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
    --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1

# Generate report
python3 /home/assistant/scripts/generate_report.py \
    --input-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
    --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1

echo "Benchmark completed at $(date)" >> "$LOG_FILE"
